{{Top|canon=Aldera security forces}}
The '''Aldera Peace Force''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] that operated on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Even in the most dangerous sections of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], this police force kept order and used non-lethal methods to subdue and restrain those few malcontents that did not respect the local laws. Unless the crimes were of a violent nature, any offenders were normally confined to their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for the duration of their stay or even escorted out of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
